cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship galley and mess hall — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — standing with one foot up on a step; her private orbital sleeper-train cabin — the train briefly enters zero gravity during her quiet wake-up; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — standing; an empty orbital recreation dome with a shallow indoor putting green and a star-filled panoramic window — she watches a small white practice ball complete a very slow curve toward the hole and leans forward in amused suspense; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — carries a paper shopping bag at her side; the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — swimming breaststroke; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — standing with one foot up on a step; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a cocktail glass by the stem at chest height; a red carpet and award hall with camera flashes — carries a camera by its grip at her side
